plos.title: Program and build software
plos.description: Graduates write correct, well-structured programs and construct software artefacts from requirements to working code.

plos.title: Reason algorithmically
plos.description: Graduates analyse problems computationally, trace and prove algorithm behaviour, and reason about efficiency.

plos.title: Design systems and make engineering judgements
plos.description: Graduates select appropriate structures and strategies for a problem and understand how operating systems and engineered software behave.

plos.title: Apply data-driven and intelligent methods
plos.description: Graduates build, train and evaluate data-driven solutions on top of sound algorithmic foundations.
